from.place: Proof (3), tensor-map paragraph: 'its transpose is built from the projection formula and $\varepsilon_A$' -- the inverse of the compact-support projection formula used in that transpose, for an arbitrary finite coefficient ring

title: Compact-support projection formula on pro-etale sites with arbitrary finite l-primary coefficients
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum with $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ and a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k)$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. Let $R$ be a finite commutative ring with $\ell^nR=0$ for some $n\geq1$; no flatness over $\mathbf Z/\ell^n$ and no presentation of $R$ as a quotient of a discrete valuation ring is assumed. Let $X$, $\bar X$ and $Y$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes, let $j:X\hookrightarrow\bar X$ be an open immersion and $p:\bar X\to Y$ a proper $k$-morphism [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties, def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-proper-morphism], and put $f=p\circ j$. Use the ordinary, uncompleted, unbounded derived categories $D(T_{\mathrm{proét}},R)$ of module sheaves over the constant ring $R_T$ on the small pro-étale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], their K-flat derived tensor product $\otimes^{\mathbf L}_R$ [def-weil-derived-tensor], the derived inverse and direct images with their adjunctions $Lu^*\dashv Ru_*$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], and extension by zero $j_!$ [def-weil-extension-by-zero]; put $Rf_{!,R}=Rp_*j_!$.

For $M\in D(X_{\mathrm{proét}},R)$ and $K\in D(Y_{\mathrm{proét}},R)$ let $\operatorname{PF}_{R;M,K}$ be the composite
$$
Rf_{!,R}M\otimes^{\mathbf L}_RK=(Rp_*j_!M)\otimes^{\mathbf L}_RK\xrightarrow{\ \pi_p\ }Rp_*\bigl(j_!M\otimes^{\mathbf L}_RLp^*K\bigr)\xrightarrow{\ Rp_*(\pi_j)\ }Rp_*j_!\bigl(M\otimes^{\mathbf L}_RLj^*Lp^*K\bigr)\cong Rf_{!,R}\bigl(M\otimes^{\mathbf L}_RLf^*K\bigr),
$$
where $\pi_p$ is the proper projection map (the adjoint transpose under $Lp^*\dashv Rp_*$ of the counit $Lp^*Rp_*j_!M\to j_!M$ tensored with $1_{Lp^*K}$, after the pullback/tensor comparison $Lp^*(V\otimes^{\mathbf L}_RW)\cong Lp^*V\otimes^{\mathbf L}_RLp^*W$), $\pi_j:j_!M\otimes^{\mathbf L}_RN\to j_!(M\otimes^{\mathbf L}_Rj^{-1}N)$ is the canonical extension-by-zero projection map with $N=Lp^*K$, and the last identification is the composition isomorphism $Lj^*Lp^*\cong Lf^*$.

If $M$ and $K$ have intrinsically constructible cohomology sheaves [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf] vanishing outside a finite range of degrees, then $\operatorname{PF}_{R;M,K}$ is an isomorphism in $D(Y_{\mathrm{proét}},R)$, natural in $M$ and $K$.
